hypothesis: A tokenless uncertainty-gated two-slot primitive memory will reuse a learned 3-input causal operation under changed public bindings after interference, while rejecting incompatible memories. It must outperform fully-trained equal-information/equal-capacity Bayesian cache and local-only controls, not merely a memoryless baseline.
scientific_limits: An eight-bit Boolean truth table is one of 256 explicitly bounded primitives, and the causal port map is publicly supplied. Reuse is not unrestricted relationship discovery, autonomous reasoning, unseen-context science or native Yggdrasil learning.

world.action: one actual do flips the public fourth-port input bit; pre and post public x,y observed
world.primitive: A 3-input Boolean table mask in [0,255]; y = table[4*a+2*b+c] XOR x[fourth]; ports=(a,b,c,fourth) are PUBLIC with all four distinct. No hidden mask or world family metadata to learners.
world.sampling: For each fixed fixture/group/phase, donor and interference expose one one-bit-do pair for each 3-bit input code (8 pairs, 16 public rows); receiver exposes exactly 2 pairs for two distinct codes selected by ascending SHA256('AAI12U|fixture|group|code'), then evaluates all 60 inputs not seen in receiver. The three unrelated remaining x-bits and fourth-port baseline are deterministic SHA256 values, chosen before results. All arms observe identical public rows and available action consequences.
world.capacity: Every arm may retain at most two 8-bit table slots plus eight confidence counts per slot; all see the same donor, interference, and recipient examples, but only the candidate's learner may decide which previous table to reuse. Matched two-slot Bayesian cache has identical state and information.

methods.candidate: Retain donor and interference ternary-operator masks and support counts keyed by canonical port-role input codes (not original absolute input positions). On receiver four public rows, choose whichever cached primitive minimizes public mismatch if its observed mismatches are zero AND its unseen-code confidence is >=0.75. Otherwise fall back to local 256-table posterior with Beta(1,1) votes. Never inspect recipient hidden mask or withheld outcomes.
methods.equal_capacity_bayesian: Two-slot Bayesian cache: using exactly same donor/interference counts, calculate smoothed public likelihood over receiver examples and choose posterior mixture/maximum-likelihood cached table without candidate's structural uncertainty accept/reject threshold. Deterministic tie break donor slot.
methods.local_only: Recipient 4 rows only; per-input-code Beta(1,1) posterior; tied prediction 0.
methods.last_slot_reuse: Use most recent interference table independent of receiver evidence; same two-slot memory available but does not choose based on evidence.
methods.donor_only_fixed: Use donor slot regardless of evidence; negative shortcut control.
methods.prior: Uniform across 256 ternary masks, no pretrained weights, hidden truth, transformer, token labels or imported dataset.
methods.cold: Serializable canonical JSON public port/observations, two tables+counts; restore before receiver evaluation and verify predicted outputs and SHA unchanged; memory cannot see private group class.

metrics: measured complete donor+interference+recipient training/prediction wall time by arm

gates.classify: Only if all frozen gates pass => DEV_ADMITTED_SCIENCE_UNVERIFIED. Any miss => DEV_NO_GO_NO_SCIENCE. Invalid if hidden source fields, mismatched intervention events, disjointness breach, privileged oracle in model, or model-specific data.
gates.stop: One frozen mechanical screen. No changes to thresholds, world tables, action budgets, public ports, codes, or selection policies following measured results. No primary science, CI/merge authority, or production integration.
